Carpal tunnel syndrome: local inj (or PO)
Plantar fasciitis: inj ⍉1st-line (↑risk of fascia rupture + fat pad atrophy) → short-term only - topical: limited evidence

Pericarditis: refractory/recurr only - ⍉routine early (↑recurr) - ⍉after MI (impairs myocard heal)
▪︎Alopecia areata: intralesional corticosteroid (triamcinolone q4–6 wks) - topical corticosteroid (fluocinolone acetonide cream BID)
▪︎Pityriasis rosea: may improve lesions + pruritus but ⍉routine (lack of evidence - relapse concern)
Nasal polyps + allergic rhinitis: short course
Lichen planus: topical or PO steroids (severity-dep)
Aphthous stomatitis: complex/refractory (PO prednisone x4-7 days)
▪︎Bact meningitis: dexamethasone w abx (adjunct) → ↓inflam + prevent neuro comps (ex hearing loss)
▪︎Sarcoidosis: tx of choice (prednisone, up to 6mo b4 taper)
▪︎Berylliosis: Sxtomatic + abnl PFTs (ex, prednisone) - most need lifelong ↓dose
▪︎Primary AI (Addison): lifelong replace (prednisone · hydrocortisone · dexamethasone) + mineralocorticoid (fludrocortisone)
